blind.description: An ornate traditional wooden nightstand or bedside table. The top has a raised gallery lip with an arched back rail and corner posts. Below the tabletop is a single shallow drawer with a small brass pull knob, and beneath that is a paneled cupboard door adorned with a carved relief emblem and small knob. The corners feature decorative turned pilaster columns, and the unit rests on four turned bun/ball feet.
blind.from_above: A square wooden top framed by raised guard rails on the rear and sides, with four square corner posts visible, casting an angular shadow toward the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% of the figure's height (roughly 2.3 feet tall) and slightly wider than the figure's cylindrical torso.
